primary_title: The transcriptional control of the VEGFA-VEGFR1 (FLT1) axis in alternatively polarized murine and human macrophages
decision_basis: Review-led STAT6 macrophage transcription framework; the cited primary directly identifies an IL-4/STAT6-dependent Flt1 enhancer program.
limitations_preserved: STAT6 occupancy, chromatin activation and Stat6-dependent Flt1 induction support early gene-level activation; EGR2 contributes to later expression, and macrophage/species/hypoxia context must be retained. Do not infer FLT1 protein signaling, VEGFA secretion, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: The transcriptional control of the VEGFA-VEGFR1 (FLT1) axis in alternatively polarized murine and human macrophages
decision_basis: Review-led STAT6 macrophage transcription framework; the cited primary directly identifies an IL-4/STAT6-dependent repressive Vegfa enhancer program.
limitations_preserved: STAT6 occupancy, reduced enhancer activity and Stat6-dependent Vegfa repression support gene-level negative regulation; macrophage/species/time-course and EGR2 context must be retained. Do not infer loss of secreted VEGFA in every cell state, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: LRH-1 mediates anti-inflammatory and antifungal phenotype of IL-13-activated macrophages through the PPARgamma ligand synthesis
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies Nr5a2/LRH-1 as an IL-13/STAT6-regulated macrophage gene with direct STAT6 promoter occupancy.
limitations_preserved: STAT6 promoter occupancy, site-mutant reporter loss and Stat6 dependence support NR5A2/LRH-1 gene activation; preserve IL-13/macrophage and promoter-site context and do not infer LRH-1 activity, metabolite production, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: The transcription factor MafB promotes anti-inflammatory M2 polarization and cholesterol efflux in macrophages
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies MafB as an IL-4/STAT6-regulated macrophage gene with STAT6 promoter occupancy and reporter activation.
limitations_preserved: STAT6 recruitment and promoter-reporter activation support gene-level MAFB regulation, with C/EBPbeta cooperation and macrophage context required; do not infer MafB protein sufficiency, downstream polarization, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: Tpl2 kinase regulates T cell interferon-gamma production and host resistance to Toxoplasma gondii
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies Map3k8/Tpl2 as an IL-12/STAT4-regulated Th1 gene with STAT4 promoter occupancy and Stat4-dependent induction.
limitations_preserved: STAT4 promoter occupancy and Stat4-dependent Map3k8 induction support gene-level transcription, with T-cell IL-12 and infection context required; preserve the later Tpl2-to-ERK/IFN-gamma findings as downstream and do not infer universal STAT4 regulation, SCI or terminal-TF effects.
